purpose: Bounded SECURITY DEFINER capability that atomically withdraws the exact current placement of one self-owned Activity Schedule, closes its open history episode, records real current absence, and retains Activity, Schedule, MaterialState, and history.

routine.return_type: TABLE(schedule_ref uuid, previous_material_state_ref uuid, unschedule_operation_id text, created_at timestamp with time zone, replayed boolean)

state_history.material_state_behavior: Creates no MaterialState and preserves the withdrawn placement state unchanged.
state_history.current_binding: Locks the Schedule, requires the exact expected current placement, closes its open history and deletes only explicit currentness.
state_history.chronology: The prior history episode closes at one authoritative created_at instant; no replacement episode is opened.
state_history.immutability_policy: Same operation and exact intent replay the receipt; different intent or stale expected state conflicts.

lifecycle.delete_behavior: Routine removal is migration-only and downgrade fails closed after B02-D operation receipts exist.

obligations: function is dante_owner SECURITY DEFINER with trusted search_path
runtime has EXECUTE only and no direct receipt/current/history DML
only an Activity Schedule belonging to the authenticated self scope is admitted
stale exact expected state conflicts before currentness is withdrawn
accepted unschedule closes history and removes current binding atomically without deleting semantic records
